metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 inspector and renderer in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with a root [main.js](/workspace/main.js) launcher for `node main.js --input ... --output ...`.

The program handles public headers, VLRs and EVLRs, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform fields and payloads, and Extra Bytes metadata. It reports invalid requests and malformed or inconsistent LAS documents in the specified response format.

Syntax checks passed, and I ran a render-to-inspect round trip that preserved the sample UUID and point data.
